steps.quote: The service desk logs the incident
The service desk rates its severity
The service desk adds a low severity incident to the weekly backlog
The service desk assigns a medium severity incident to the duty engineer
The service desk escalates a high severity incident to the incident manager
The incident manager opens a call with the affected teams
The incident manager assigns the incident to the duty engineer
The duty engineer fixes the incident
The service desk closes the ticket once the incident is fixed
